findings.locator: Report PDFp3 symbol footnote; setup PDFp4; report PDFp5 Sec2.2
findings.finding: Post-consolidation relative density includes the static shear stage when present. Height is free during static shear and constrained during subsequent cyclic loading.
Reported axial strain combines specimen deformation and system compliance. A specimen-only volume strain or exact constant-volume check cannot be inferred from it without correction.
Adopted literature values Gs=2.65, emax=.78, emin=.51. These are not new campaign-specific measurements and do not fill missing torsion particle-density cells.
Average preparation diameter64.2mm and height23.5mm, not per-specimen post-consolidation dimensions.
Vertical/horizontal load cells, LVDTs and bender elements identified. No numerical sensor calibration accuracy or compliance correction supplied in these documents.

findings.finding: 54 state rows;54 unique nominal-condition filename candidates.42 filename void-ratio tokens differ from individual printed eac and instead coincide with reported series-average labels. No CSV contents or physical identities verified.
